source_name: ЦРРСМ — Интернет дистрибутивен систем (IDS) bulk data distribution
source_subtype: licensed bulk data feed / distribution system
why_relevant: Contract-based data distribution channel of the Central Registry: registered users sign a usage agreement, pre-pay (reported minimum ~5,000 MKD) and order datasets/extracts systematically. This is the legitimate route to structured, machine-readable registry change data instead of scraping.

source_name: ЦРРСМ — Пријава за упис на промена (e-filing forms and instructions)
why_relevant: Documents the exact filing taxonomy and form fields used when a company registers a change of manager/board — tells the collector which change codes and document types to look for, and the legal deadlines that make the record timely.

source_name: ЦРРСМ — Регистар на вистински сопственици (beneficial ownership register)
why_relevant: Statutory UBO register operated by CRM with the AML agency. For payment institutions and e-money institutions (often small, privately held) it reveals ownership and control changes that accompany, and often precede, management changes.

source_name: ЈП Службен весник на РСМ — интернет издание (Official Gazette)
why_relevant: Official gazette; since 27 July 2021 the electronic edition is legally binding equally with print. Publishes laws, decrees, and appointment/dismissal decisions (решенија за именување и разрешување) for state-owned and state-appointed bodies — including Развојна банка, NBRSM organs, and supervisory appointments touching the banking sector.

source_name: Службен весник — Бесплатен пристап до изданија (free issue archive)
why_relevant: Free-access subset of gazette issues; provides an unpaid entry point for testing text extraction pipelines and for capturing decrees published in the open, before deciding on a paid subscription.

source_name: НБРСМ — Регистар на институции за електронски пари
why_relevant: Supervisory register of licensed e-money institutions. Defines the exact population of entities whose registry filings must be monitored, and registers themselves record authorised persons and licence status changes.

source_name: НБРСМ — Одлука за издавање дозволи и согласности на платежна институција и институција за електронски пари и за содржината и начинот на водење на регистрите
why_relevant: The by-law that defines what the payment-institution/EMI registers must contain and how they are kept — tells the collector precisely which fields (including authorised persons and management) are legally required to appear, and hence what can be monitored.

source_name: НБРСМ — Одлука за издавање согласности (пречистен текст)
why_relevant: Sets out the Governor's prior-consent procedure for appointing bank management-board and supervisory-board members. Establishes that every bank board appointment passes through NBRSM before it can be registered at CRM — i.e. a second, earlier signal point in the legally compelled chain.

source_name: Закон за банките (consolidated text on NBRSM site)
why_relevant: Primary statute defining bank governance bodies, appointment/consent duties and registration obligations. It is the legal basis that makes the registry/gazette layer exhaustive, and it fixes the correct Macedonian terminology for board roles used in filings.

source_name: Македонска берза (MSE) — Објави од друштва: 'Промени во органите на управување и раководење'
why_relevant: Statutory issuer-disclosure channel: listed banks (and Развојна банка) must announce changes in management and supervisory bodies. The announcement category is explicitly 'Промени во органите на управување и раководење', giving a clean, dated, structured feed that usually precedes the CRM registration.

source_name: Комисија за хартии од вредност на РСМ (Securities and Exchange Commission)
why_relevant: Regulator of issuer disclosure; publishes the corporate-governance code for listed companies and decisions/approvals affecting listed banks' governance. Useful for interpreting what issuers must disclose about board changes and for cross-checking MSE filings.

source_name: uslugi.gov.mk — national e-services catalogue entry for Централен регистар / Службен весник
why_relevant: Government service catalogue enumerating every CRM service with its formal name, fee and delivery channel. Efficient way to discover registry products (extracts, certificates, data services) that are not obvious from the CRM site navigation.

source_name: slobodenpristap.mk / АСЈИ (Agency for Free Access to Public Information) — FOI route to CRM and NBRSM
why_relevant: Public FOI request platform with the Central Registry (and other bodies) listed as an information holder, including named information officers. Legal fallback for obtaining structured lists of registered management changes when the portal offers only per-entity paid extracts.

source_name: OpenCorporates — jurisdiction 'The Central Register of Macedonia'
why_relevant: Third-party mirror/aggregator of MK company-register data with an API, usable for entity resolution and officer-name normalisation across languages/transliterations. Coverage is partial and lags the official register, so it is a convenience layer, never the authority.

source_name: Open Government Partnership — commitment MK0122 'Public access to the Central Register'
why_relevant: Documents the government commitment to make basic CRM data publicly and freely available, with implementation status. Tells the collector how far free access extends now and what is due to open next — i.e. how the access constraints on this cell will change.

source_name: Македонска банкарска асоцијација (MBA) — Претседателство
why_relevant: Canonical page naming the elected President, Vice-President and Executive Secretary of the national banking association, each identified with their bank and executive role (currently Maja Stevkova Shterieva, CFO/Management Board member of Komercijalna banka AD Skopje; Bojan Stojanoski, Risk GM/Board member of Stopanska banka Skopje; Milena Percinkova, Executive Secretary). Changes to this page are direct leadership-move signals in both the association and the member banks.

source_name: MBA — Историски податоци (mandate history)
why_relevant: Narrates the succession of association presidents and the reasons mandates ended — e.g. Kosta Mitrovski's mandate terminated early on 12 June 2019 because he ceased to be a Management Board member of UNIBank AD Skopje. This is a rare source that ties association-office turnover explicitly to bank-level board departures, giving a historical baseline for leadership-change detection.

source_name: MBA — Собрание, Комисии и SKIBOR панел (working bodies)
why_relevant: The association's About/Activities structure enumerates the Assembly, standing Commissions (комисии) and the SKIBOR panel. Commission chairs and SKIBOR panel banks are the sub-institutional map of which bank executives hold payments/risk/ESG weight; commission composition also enumerates the member population. Membership per the About page = all banks and savings houses licensed under the Law on Banks, plus KIBS AD Skopje (clearing house) and Macedonian Credit Bureau AD Skopje — i.e. an implicit but authoritative member roster.

source_name: MBA — Соопштенија / Настани (announcements & events feed)
why_relevant: Assembly sessions, election announcements, EBF delegation appointments, ESG-sector and MiCreS project staffing are announced here first, typically before trade press picks them up. Highest-recall single feed for MK banking-association governance events.

source_name: Стопанска комора на Северна Македонија — здруженија и групации index
why_relevant: The Chamber organises members into ~15 Associations, ~12 Асоцијации and ~38 Групации, each with a named president, vice-presidents and a Chamber secretary. It is the single richest enumeration of which companies operate in a given sector in MK, and the elected chairs are leadership signals. The ICT Association page currently names Blagoj Hristov (Makedonski Telekom) as president with Valentina Taseva (Semos Education) and Aneta Antova Pesheva (Ultra) as vice-presidents.

source_name: Стопанска комора — Групација на небанкарски финансиски друштва
why_relevant: Enumerates the non-bank financial population — financial companies, leasing, pension companies, insurers, card processors — with an elected chair (reported as Nikola Joshevski, GM/partner at SN Finance). Named participants observed include Tigo Finance, Osiguruvanje Makedonija (VIG), KB Prvo pension company, Croatia Osiguruvanje-Zivot, Sparkasse Leasing, Euroins, and Casys (International Card System). Casys is a payments processor, making this group directly on-scope for payments-sector actor mapping.

source_name: Стопанска комора на Северна Македонија — Вести
why_relevant: Chamber news reports constitutive sessions, elections of association/group presidents, and joint events with NBRM (e.g. an NBRM workshop on practical SEPA payment aspects for companies). Election reporting here often predates or supplements the static officer pages.

source_name: MASIT — Управен одбор / Надзорен одбор / Суд на честа
why_relevant: The ICT chamber's elected bodies were re-constituted at an inaugural Management Board session reported for 15 May 2025: Management Board — Jordan Dimitrovski (Aitonix, President), Blagoj Hristov (Makedonski Telekom), Dragan Chepujnoski (A1 Macedonia), Damjan Manchevski (MAK-System), Sofche Jovanovska (Scale Focus), Vesna Ivanoska (Avenga Academy), Kostandina Pareska Medarski (Valtech), Filip Petrovski (Data Masters), Zoran Lazarevski (Ultra); Supervisory Board — Goran Mitev (Edusoft), Mile Stoilovski (Bransys), Marijana Andric (Marand); Court of Honour — Dashmir Istrefi (Hoyo Tech), Sasho Jovanovski (Datalab), Jana Damevska (Infigo). These are named IT-vendor executives, several of whom serve banking clients.

source_name: MASIT — Members directory (per-company pages)
why_relevant: One structured page per member company under a predictable /en/members-en/{slug}/ pattern — the canonical enumeration of MK ICT vendors, including payments-relevant members observed such as KIBS AD Skopje (the interbank clearing house), Finelevate, Nextsense, Bransys, Innox, CMX Solutions, Insight Group, Valtech, Factum, Deltatre and KabTel. This directory is the population map every vendor-side hiring and org-change cell should monitor.

source_name: MASIT — News feed
why_relevant: Reports assembly elections, new-member admissions and committee formation for the ICT chamber; the fastest signal that the vendor-side actor map has changed.

source_name: AmCham North Macedonia — Board of Directors
why_relevant: AmCham's board is elected and includes senior finance executives; Slavko Projkoski (CFO, Makedonski Telekom) is reported as President and Aleksandra Ivanovska (GM North Macedonia & Kosovo, Roche) as Second Vice President, with new board members elected around the chamber's 25th anniversary. Board turnover is a direct leadership-move signal for the companies represented.
